thread:
lena: heads-up — we're seeing a simultaneous soft-ECC/Xid spike in us-west2 and eu-central this morning. Capacity in us-west2 is down ~18% from drains; p95 for hosted-generation routes is climbing. I see a bunch of Xid 13/32 and NVLINK errs. Starting triage now.

ajay: oncall here, looking. tailing prober and nvml dumps now. any recent driver or firmware pushes in those regions?

ops-bot: auto-evac triggered: prober_ecc_threshold exceeded on rack-rw-41 and rack-rw-43 (policy: proactive-drain). Drains queued: 26.

marcus: confirming telemetry — soft ECC counts jumped ~2x over 12min in both regions. NVLINK error frames present on a small cohort. sample logs:
```
[2026-03-18T09:12:03Z] GPU0: Xid=32 NVLINK_ERR rc=0x3
[2026-03-18T09:12:09Z] GPU1: CE soft-ecc count 185 -> 412 (10m)
```

ajay: if probes are flapping we should consider suppressing proactive drains short-term to avoid bleeding capacity. propose: set /sre/probe/suppress=true for 15m while we hotpatch.

lena: we paused proactive evacs in us-west2 already at 09:20 but not in eu-central. what's the current drain/replacement count?

kevin: current numbers: draining cards 42, reboots in flight 8, hardware replacements requested 3. net capacity bleed estimate ~17.6% across affected AZs.

ian: quick mitigation idea — shift new scheduling to dedicated spare pool in adjacent region + throttle batch sizes to reduce tail latency. Cost impact estimate: ~$6k/day if we warm a 12-GPU spare pool in us-west2. :money_with_wings:

ajay: plan: run targeted hotpatch to 2.1.3-rc driver on suspected racks (rack-rw-41,rack-rw-43,rack-rw-47) with small splay. If that drops CE rates we can scale the roll. Command I will use:
```
./run-hotpatch --racks rack-rw-41,rack-rw-43,rack-rw-47 --driver 2.1.3-rc --splay 600 --notify-channel #eng-infra
```

lena: okay proceed but coordinate with @marcus for telemetry checks post-patch. keep an eu-central canary running. also notify support teams to throttle new tenant capacity allocations.

sophie: opening customer notice draft and posting to #support-notices. draft: "We're experiencing transient capacity reductions in select regions impacting throughput for some API requests. No data loss. Engineering is actively triaging and we expect partial restoration within the hour."

ops-bot: hotpatch job scheduled: job_id=patch-239876-01 started on rack-rw-41 at ts=2398765450.

lena: update — hotpatch completed on rack-rw-41 and rack-rw-43 (first two racks). Initial telemetry: soft-ECC counts on patched nodes down ~60% vs pre-patch; capacity restored ~3.2% on those AZs. Continuing roll and watching for regressions.

marcus: monitoring dashboards show p95 decreasing on canary slices. will post after 30m if stable.

ajay: will hold on replacements until we confirm driver impact. If errors persist after full roll we'll schedule hardware swaps.

lena: thanks everyone. keep short updates here, escalate to incidents if we hit >25% net capacity loss or sustained Xid 13 > 5m.
